Blessed is Allah. All power and the whole kingdom are in His hand. He can do everything.
Allah made death and life to test you. He wants to see who does the best things. He is strong and He forgives.
He made seven skies, one over the other. You will not see any mistake in what Allah made. Look again. Do you see any cracks?
Look again and again. Your eyes will come back tired, and they will find no mistake.
We put lamps in the sky, the stars. We use them to chase away the devils. For the devils We made the punishment of the Fire.
For people who say no to their Lord, there is the punishment of Hell. What a terrible place to go!
When they are thrown in, they will hear it roar and boil.
It is almost bursting with anger. Each time a group is thrown in, the guards ask them: Did no warner come to you?
They will say: Yes, a warner came. But we said it was a lie. We said: Allah did not send anything. You are very wrong.
They will say: If only we had listened and thought, we would not be with the people of the Fire.
So they will say what bad things they did. Away with the people of the Fire.
People who fear their Lord, even when no one sees, will be forgiven and have a big reward.
Whether you speak quietly or loudly, Allah knows what is in your hearts.
Would the One who made everything not know? He knows even the smallest things.
He made the earth easy for you to live on. Walk on it and eat from what Allah gave you. You will go back to Him.
Are you sure that Allah, who is above, will not make the earth shake and swallow you?
Or are you sure that Allah will not send a strong storm on you? Then you would know how My warning is.
People before them also said it was a lie. See how My punishment was!
Do they not look at the birds above them, opening and closing their wings? Only the Most Kind holds them up. He sees everything.
Who is there that can be an army for you against the Most Kind? People who say no are only fooling themselves.
Who can give you food if He holds it back? But they keep on being proud and running away.
Who is better guided? A person who walks with his face down, or a person who walks straight on a straight path?
Say: He made you. He gave you ears, eyes and hearts. But you hardly ever say thank you.
Say: He spread you out on the earth, and you will be gathered back to Him.
They say: When will this promise come, if you are telling the truth?
Say: Only Allah knows when. I am only a clear warner.
But when they see it coming, the faces of people who said no will turn sad. They will be told: This is what you asked for.
Say: Think about it. Whether Allah ends me and those with me, or shows us kindness, who will save the people who said no from a painful punishment?
Say: He is the Most Kind. We believe in Him and we trust Him. Soon you will know who is clearly wrong.
Say: Think about it. If your water sank down into the ground, who would bring you clean, flowing water?
